headline: Warden Posts Fall in Fisherman's Row as Weathered Expanse Grinds On
war_summary: Since our last edition the tide has run hard through Fisherman's Row: where the Wardens lately held five of nine strategic posts, their flag now flies over but two, the Colonials having taken three amid a night of furious exchange that shows no sign of slackening. The Weathered Expanse remains the war's furnace — fifty-seven base actions in a day, six inside the final two hours, Crow's Nest and Frostmarch again the busiest grounds, with the Colonial count there now six of nine. Stlican Shelf, quiet in our previous report, has roared back to life about Fort Hoarfrost and Breaker Town, its bases split four Warden to five Colonial. Mooring County, by contrast, has been closed out: the Wardens now hold all twelve posts. Callahan's Passage stands unchanged at eight Warden to two Colonial, yet its casualty ledgers swell by the hour on both sides. Casualty tallies climb steeply along the Nevish Line as well, though few bases changed hands there, while Palantine Berm has gone still. It is day 392; thirty-four victory towns decide this war, and no victor is yet named.
